name: ecomacademy-skills
description: Claude Code skills and plugins for Shopify merchants — by Ecommerce Academy.

plugins.name: eca-pdp
plugins.description: Ecommerce Academy Product Detail Page (ECA PDP). Connects to a Shopify store via the Shopify CLI, duplicates the live theme into a development theme, and installs a high-converting product page template built for Horizon.

plugins.name: eca-promotion
plugins.description: Ecommerce Academy Promotion Builder. Plan and build a complete promotional sale campaign — offer, email/SMS, paid ads, on-site changes, and a dated Go-Live timeline.

plugins.name: eca-ecommerce-agent
plugins.description: Ecommerce Academy skills bundle — brand intelligence, email marketing campaigns, competitor analysis, Meta ad copywriting, customer persona building, SEO/AI blog writing, UGC video scripts, SEO/AI store audits, and Meta ads analysis (4PI). New skills are added here over time; install this one plugin to stay current with all of them.

plugins.name: eca-operations-agent
plugins.description: Ecommerce Academy Operations Coworker — turn repeatable tasks into reusable Claude skills with the TEACH framework, and build high-converting ad landing pages into your Shopify theme.

plugins.name: eca-black-friday-blueprint
plugins.description: Ecommerce Academy Black Friday Blueprint — everything you need for an outstanding BFCM, built on your own data. Pulls last year's Q4 and BFCM performance, cross-checks it against this year's goals, and recommends a core offer, a Cyber Monday offer and a pre-agreed Plan B, all captured in a BFCM Campaign Master File.  What's new (v1.7.0): Update to BFCM Offer Skill
